whenToUse: Paging long lists and search results; a table footer with range and rows per page.
SEO-friendly page links on websites and cursor paging for APIs.
avoidWhen: Short lists that fit — show everything.
Feeds where infinite scroll or Load more is expected.
a11y: A labelled nav; the current page has aria-current=page.
Previous/Next buttons have text labels or aria-labels.
